g.text: Cold leaf payloads: decoded types and schema cardinality
Arrows describe decoded records, not separate LMDB rows.
All three variants use sorted vectors of encoded element bytes.
Cardinality labels describe the schema, not this workload's observed limits.
Par can recursively contain more Par values through its message fields.
Blake2b256Hash wraps Vec<u8>; valid hash contents have 32 bytes.
Actual counts and byte distributions: leaf-measurements.md.
Sources: cold_store.rs, internal.rs, trace/event.rs, serializers.rs, RhoTypes.proto.
